sloka: तां समुत्थाय गच्छन्तीं कामबाणवशं गतः ।करे गृहीत्वा लज्जन्तीं स्मयमानो ऽभ्यभाषत ।। ७.२६.२० ॥
transliteration: tāṁ samutthāya gacchantīṁ kāmabāṇavaśaṁ gataḥ ।kare gṛhītvā lajjantīṁ smayamāno 'bhyabhāṣata ।। 7.26.20 ॥

translations.english: Having risen, Ravana, fallen under the sway of Cupid's arrows, seized her hand as she was going, and smiling, spoke to the blushing woman.
